name: Trouble in the Valley

angles.text: As a human, you may recognize the sea green and anchor colors of Kul Tiras. Soldiers from this reclusive seafaring nation are a rare and unexpected sight in the valley.

faq.answer: A sharpshooter spotted Kul Tiran soldiers searching the valley below. They camped near a wrecked caravan to the south, and local scouts are sent to investigate their purpose.
faq.q: What are Kul Tiran soldiers doing in the valley?

faq.answer: The Kul Tiran soldiers camp near a ruined caravan south of the vantage point overlooking the valley.
faq.q: Where is the Kul Tiran camp located?

faq.answer: A scout watching the valley inspected the human group through a rifle scope and recognized Kul Tiras by its uniforms and insignia.
faq.q: How was the Kul Tiran presence discovered?

faq.answer: You are sent south to the wrecked caravan to confront the Kul Tiran soldiers and discover what brought them to search the area.
faq.q: What is the objective of investigating the camp?

faq.answer: The soldiers are armed foreigners searching the land around a destroyed caravan without explanation. Scouts see them as a threat to be subdued so their intentions can be uncovered.
faq.q: Why are the Kul Tiran soldiers treated as enemies?

faq.answer: Walton, the hermit tanner watching the valley, spotted the soldiers through his rifle scope. He hired an adventurer to eliminate them and learn why they were there.
faq.q: Who detected the soldiers in the valley?

sections.body: A rifleman watching the lowlands spotted human soldiers searching the valley floor. Through his scope, he recognized the heraldry and livery of Kul Tiras. Armed foreigners rarely work so openly here, and their presence has raised alarm.
sections.title: Suspicious Activity in the Valley

sections.body: The soldiers have camped near a ruined caravan to the south. What they seek among the wreckage remains unknown. Local observers consider their armed presence an immediate concern, so investigators are sent to eliminate them and uncover the purpose of their search.
sections.title: The Wrecked Caravan

summary: A squad of Kul Tiran soldiers is searching the valley, and their purpose is unknown. They have camped near a wrecked caravan to the south, drawing the attention of local scouts.
attribution: In-game quest text: Trouble in the Valley
